correctness.rationale: For real diagonal E, E E^T = d^2 I+(1-d^2)e1e1^T gives the exact top eigenvalue of Q^T E^2 Q. A deterministic one-axis scaling lemma gives ||P_{D_h R}e1||^2 = S/(S+h^2(1-S)), and Gaussian Haar invariance gives S~Beta(b/2,(N+1-b)/2), equivalently chi-square ratio. Solving the threshold inequality proves the exact CDF with endpoints. Chi-square LLN proves both sharp fixed-width and growing-width limits. All boundaries and quantifiers were independently reconstructed; the standalone 1133-test numerical checker passed. Numerical tests are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
